tools.name: json
tools.description: Validate and pretty-print or minify JSON (errors give line and column), or convert JSON to YAML or CSV, or CSV to JSON.

tools.name: text
tools.description: Exact text facts models get wrong: word/character/grapheme counts, whether text fits X, SMS, meta title/description or custom:N limits (with a truncated version), letter frequency, case conversion, slugs, JavaScript regex matches and replacements, lorem ipsum, and OpenAI token counts.

tools.name: dates
tools.description: Calendar math: days between dates, add days/weeks/months/years, exact age (with exam cut-offs), business days skipping public holidays (US federal by default; UK, EU, CA, AU, IN, SG, AE), a country's holiday list, and cron schedules in plain English.

tools.name: time
tools.description: Current time anywhere (with DST state and next clock change), convert a wall-clock time between zones, or convert Unix timestamps to and from dates. Accepts IANA zones or common names (ET, PT, UTC, London, IST).

tools.name: encode
tools.description: Base64 and URL encode/decode (UTF-8 safe), MD5/SHA-1/SHA-256/384/512 hashes, new UUID v4/v7 or ULID (or read a ULID's time), and decode a JWT's header and payload without verifying it.

tools.name: convert
tools.description: Unit conversion (imperial and metric: length, weight, volume, area, speed, temperature, data, pressure, energy), color hex/rgb/hsl, WCAG contrast ratio, numbers in words and $ or lakh/crore formats, Markdown to HTML, pixels vs print size at a DPI, and CGPA to percentage (official formulas).

tools.name: finance
tools.description: Monthly loan payment (EMI) with a yearly amortization summary, simple and compound interest (with monthly contributions), percentage math (of, what percent, change, add, subtract), and tax added to or removed from a price at a given rate (VAT, sales tax, or India GST with CGST/SGST/IGST split).

tools.name: calculate
tools.description: Exact decimal arithmetic for an expression (no floating-point drift: 0.1+0.2 = 0.3; + − × ÷ ^ %, sqrt, ln, log, round, min, max, pi), summary statistics for a list of numbers, rounding with a chosen mode, and adult BMI from lb/in or kg/cm.

tools.name: income_tax
tools.description: Estimate income tax from official tables. us_federal: 2025 or 2026 IRS brackets, standard deduction (with 65+/blind extras) or itemized, by filing status. india: FY 2025-26 or 2026-27, new vs old regime with 87A rebate, surcharge and cess. Each answer cites its source.

tools.name: validate
tools.description: Check an identifier's format and check digit: US ABA routing number, EIN, SSN (format rules only), ZIP; card numbers (Luhn) and IBAN; India GSTIN, PAN, IFSC, UPI ID, Aadhaar (Verhoeff) and PIN code. Proves a value is well formed, not that it's registered. Nothing is stored.

tools.name: ifsc_lookup
tools.description: Bank, branch, address, MICR and NEFT/RTGS/IMPS/UPI support for an Indian IFSC code, from RBI's published lists via Razorpay's IFSC dataset.

tools.name: verify_links
tools.description: Check up to 20 URLs live: HTTP status, redirects, final URL, page title and canonical, and optionally whether each page contains a quote. Respects robots.txt and refuses private addresses.

tools.name: package_check
tools.description: Does this package exist (catches invented names)? Latest version, deprecation, license, repository, last publish, downloads, and the newest version matching a range. Ecosystems: npm, pypi, crates.

tools.name: verify_citation
tools.description: Check that a paper exists and get its canonical metadata (title, authors, year, venue, DOI link, retraction flag) by DOI, arXiv id, or title plus author. Uses Crossref, OpenAlex and arXiv. No abstracts.

tools.name: ui_component_lookup
tools.description: Search the ui.cuelark.com shadcn/ui registry (React components, blocks, themes) and get the shadcn CLI install command for each match.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: encode, verify_links · Private data: text, verify_links · Public sink: text, package_check · Destructive: validate.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: encode, verify_links · Private data: text, verify_links · Public sink: text, package_check · Destructive: validate

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
